# apple_subscription_introductory_offer (Resource)

Manages an introductory offer on an auto-renewable subscription — a free trial, or a discounted first period — across a set of territories.

Apple keeps **one record per territory**: the "one-week free trial everywhere" App Store Connect's UI shows as one offer is 175 records with identical terms. This resource describes the offer once and owns one record in each territory it names, reported through `offer_ids`. The records are created in a single `PATCH /v1/subscriptions/{id}` carrying them inline, so Apple commits them all or none, and read back in one listing.

An offer is either a **free trial**, listing its territories in `territory_ids`, or **paid** (`PAY_AS_YOU_GO`, `PAY_UP_FRONT`), keying the discounted price point of each territory in `price_point_ids` — the map `apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations` produces.

Only `end_date` and the set of territories change in place. Apple's update request carries the end date alone, so every other attribute forces replacement, and a territory whose price point changes is deleted and created again.

~> **A territory holds one introductory offer at a time.** Several of these resources can share a subscription — a trial in some territories and a paid offer in others, or a later offer scheduled after an earlier one ends — but not with overlapping dates in the same territory.

~> **The subscription has to be sellable in a territory** before an offer can be made there: declare `depends_on` on its `apple_subscription_availability` and price, since nothing in an offer references them.

Destroying the resource deletes its record in every territory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One offer, described once, across a set of territories. Apple keeps a record
# per territory; this resource owns one in each territory it names and creates
# them all in a single request.
#
# The subscription has to be available and priced in every territory first
# (see apple_subscription_availability and apple_subscription_price_schedule).
# Nothing in an offer references either, so when they are managed in the same
# configuration, declare the ordering with depends_on.

data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

data "apple_subscription_groups" "premium" {
  app_id = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
}

data "apple_subscriptions" "pro_monthly" {
  group_id           = data.apple_subscription_groups.premium.subscription_groups[0].id
  product_id_pattern = "^com\\.example\\.app\\.pro\\.monthly$"
}

data "apple_subscriptions" "pro_annual" {
  group_id           = data.apple_subscription_groups.premium.subscription_groups[0].id
  product_id_pattern = "^com\\.example\\.app\\.pro\\.annual$"
}

locals {
  pro_monthly_id = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_monthly.subscriptions[0].id
  pro_annual_id  = data.apple_subscriptions.pro_annual.subscriptions[0].id
}

# A one-week free trial everywhere the App Store sells.
data "apple_territories" "all" {}

resource "apple_subscription_introductory_offer" "pro_monthly_trial" {
  subscription_id = local.pro_monthly_id
  offer_mode      = "FREE_TRIAL"
  duration        = "ONE_WEEK"
  territory_ids   = data.apple_territories.all.ids
}

# Three months at 0.99 for new annual subscribers, priced in every territory
# from one base price point -- the same fan-out the price schedule uses.
data "apple_subscription_price_points" "intro_base" {
  subscription_id = local.pro_annual_id
  territories     = ["USA"]
  customer_price  = "0.99"
}

data "apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations" "intro" {
  price_point_id = data.apple_subscription_price_points.intro_base.price_points[0].id
}

resource "apple_subscription_introductory_offer" "pro_annual_discount" {
  subscription_id   = local.pro_annual_id
  offer_mode        = "PAY_AS_YOU_GO"
  duration          = "ONE_MONTH"
  number_of_periods = 3
  end_date          = "2027-06-30"

  price_point_ids = merge(
    { USA = data.apple_subscription_price_points.intro_base.price_points[0].id },
    data.apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations.intro.price_point_ids,
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration` (String) How long one period of the offer lasts: `THREE_DAYS`, `ONE_WEEK`, `TWO_WEEKS`, `ONE_MONTH`, `TWO_MONTHS`, `THREE_MONTHS`, `SIX_MONTHS` or `ONE_YEAR`. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `offer_mode` (String) What the customer pays during the offer: `FREE_TRIAL` (nothing), `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` (a discounted price every period, for `number_of_periods` periods) or `PAY_UP_FRONT` (one discounted price for the whole `duration`). A free trial takes `territory_ids`; the two paid modes take `price_point_ids`. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `subscription_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_subscription` the offer applies to. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `end_date` (String) The last date the offer is available to new subscribers, as a plain date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form. Omit it for an offer with no end. The one attribute Apple lets change in place; removing it removes the end date at Apple. Only a configured end date is compared with Apple's on refresh.
- `number_of_periods` (Number) How many `duration` periods the offer runs for. Defaults to `1`, which is what a free trial and a pay-up-front offer use; a pay-as-you-go offer of three discounted months is `duration = "ONE_MONTH"` with `number_of_periods = 3`. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `price_point_ids` (Map of String) For a **paid** offer, the discounted price point in each territory it is offered in, keyed by three-letter territory code — the shape `apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations.price_point_ids` produces. Required when `offer_mode` is `PAY_AS_YOU_GO` or `PAY_UP_FRONT` and rejected for a free trial. Price points come from the subscription's own catalogue (`apple_subscription_price_points`) and cannot be reused on another subscription. Adding or removing a territory creates or deletes its record in place; changing a territory's price point deletes its record and creates another.
- `start_date` (String) The date the offer becomes available to new subscribers, as a plain date in `YYYY-MM-DD` form — not a timestamp. Omit it for an offer available immediately. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `target_subscription_plan_type` (String) Which plan of the subscription the offer applies to: `MONTHLY` for the recurring plan or `UPFRONT` for a pre-paid one. Omit it for a subscription with a single plan. Cannot be changed after creation.
- `territory_ids` (Set of String) The three-letter Apple territory codes a **free trial** is offered in, for example `["USA", "GBR"]`, or `data.apple_territories.all.ids` for everywhere. Required when `offer_mode` is `FREE_TRIAL` and rejected otherwise. Adding or removing a territory creates or deletes that territory's record in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the subscription the offer belongs to. There is no single record for the offer at Apple — `offer_ids` holds the one per territory — so this mirrors `subscription_id`.
- `offer_ids` (Map of String) The Apple record behind the offer in each territory, keyed by territory code. Any one of them, with the subscription ID, is an import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is "<subscription_id>/<offer_id>", where the offer ID is the
# record of any one territory -- apple_subscription_introductory_offers lists
# them. Every record on the subscription with the same terms is adopted with
# it, which is what one offer across many territories looks like at Apple.
terraform import apple_subscription_introductory_offer.pro_monthly_trial 6740021496/9a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
```
